title: FixingPointSystem module manifest
description: Contract v0.5. Declares a module's identity, capabilities, parameters, settings, template functions, scenarios, byte estimates, and provenance.

type.description: Module type. The types tunnel, strike, evasion, and fuzzer are reserved: the schema accepts them, no module of them runs in v1, and no reader rejects them yet. The only rule that depends on the type is that the raw action needs a strike or fuzzer module.

engine_api.description: Engine contract versions the module supports, as a semver range such as '>=0.2, <0.3'.

license.description: SPDX license expression for module code and content. It must be compatible with GPL-3.0, and every license and exception in it must be on the allow list of the controller registry (see the module development guide, Licenses). The schema checks the length only. tools/contracts/validate.py and the registry check the expression.

parameters.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for user configurable parameters. The root must be an object schema.

settings.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for module settings, which a test configuration sets once per module under modules.<name>.settings. The root must be an object schema. A module without this key accepts no settings.

scenarios.description: Scenario files relative to the manifest.

expected_bytes.description: Estimated application payload bytes that one session of each scenario moves in both directions with default parameters, keyed by scenario name. The controller derives session rates for the throughput_bps objective from it and corrects the estimate by calibration during the run.

functions.description: Template functions that scenarios call as <module>.<name>(...). The list must equal the catalog that the extension returns from functions(), so the validator checks calls without running extension code.

wasm.description: The WebAssembly component of the module. The agent loads only the file extension.wasm at the module root, so this is the only accepted value.

capture_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the capture file that the module was made from, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. Optional, and meant for source capture.

scrub_rules.description: The scrub rules that ran, each with the version of the rule at that time. A rule version rises when the rule changes what it replaces. Optional, and meant for source capture.

scrubbed_at.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or UTC date and time (RFC 3339) of the scrub. Optional, and meant for source capture.

params.description: Parameters in positional order. A parameter without a default is required.

default.description: Value used when a call omits the argument. A bytes default is a string of hexadecimal digit pairs.
